items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let's see, Brooks had just come to town with Mamie Smith's Jazz Hounds. That sound familiar? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: I've seen pictures of, mahy pictures of you naturally, but things with Coleman Hawkins and things like that, how well did you know Hawkins?

Well, he came here in 1923, Coleman did, with Mamie Smith. He came with Harvey Brooks. I hired Harvey to play in our little four piece group. I said, "Do you want to get a little band together?" Harvey said, "Yes, I'd like to stay here." I said, "Okay, we'll organize a little band."

Four pieces, which we did. And that's when I got Leon, Harvey, Henry and myself. Harvey was -- Lionel was a very fine little young fellow, but he just would go off and get drunk, and chasing he white gals and get put in jail.
